title: CONVERT AN AFFINE FILE BETWEEN CONVENTIONS
description:
NIFTI world matrices can be used directly on mm coordinates via matrix multiplication, they use the NIFTI coordinate system, that is, positive X is right, positive Y is anterior, and positive Z is superior.  Note that wb_command assumes that world matrices transform source coordinates to target coordinates, while other tools may use affines that transform target coordinates to source coordinates.

The ITK format is used by ANTS.

You must specify exactly one -from option, but you may specify multiple -to options, and -to-flirt may be specified more than once.

inverse.description: for files that use 'target to source' convention

source_volume.description: the source volume used when generating the input affine

target_volume.description: the target volume used when generating the input affine

inverse.description: write file using 'target to source' convention

to_world.description: write output as a NIFTI 'world' affine

to_itk.description: write output as an ITK affine

source_volume.description: the volume you want to apply the transform to

target_volume.description: the target space you want the transformed volume to match

to_flirt.description: write output as a flirt matrix
